text:
Ben Chiang: Heads-up — starting around 10:03 UTC we're seeing a sudden spike in Pending GPU pods in us-west1. Dashboard shows compact-gpu-usw pool fragmentation: a small set of nodes got labeled `node-role=isolated` and are not accepting regular GPU workloads. ~120 pods Pending, many are large-gang training jobs.
Maria Lopez: I can see it too. `kubectl get nodes -l pool=compact-gpu-usw -o wide` shows 6 nodes with `node-role=isolated`. Some are Ready, some NotReady. Also seeing taints: `node.kubernetes.io/isolated:NoSchedule` on the affected ones.
autoscale-bot: autoscaler: scaleDown event: group=spot-usw-3 scaled from 6 -> 2 due to price-surge policy (timestamp 2469012200). No new nodes requested because price > threshold.
Todd Nguyen: That explains the capacity hole. The maintenance script that labeled nodes ran during the price event; combined effect is we lost compact packing and CA shrank the pool. Evictions started cascading — lower-priority jobs got killed and higher-priority ones are pending.
Jen Park: Is immediate rollback of the label safe? If we remove `node-role=isolated` we might let some infra workloads migrate back, but the spot group is still small. We should also avoid making scheduling changes that break gang scheduling for the queued jobs.
Kai Ito: Quick mitigation plan: 1) unlabel the nodes so scheduler can see them again, 2) temporarily increase min size of spot-usw-3 to 4 to stop further scale-downs, 3) run a descheduler job to consolidate small GPU pods and free contiguous capacity for gangs.
Ben Chiang: Sounds good. Maria — can you unlabel the nodes now? Use caution; do one node at a time and watch pod churn.
Maria Lopez: On it. Command I'm using: ```
kubectl label node <node-name> node-role-=isolated --overwrite
kubectl taint nodes <node-name> node.kubernetes.io/isolated:NoSchedule- || true
```  Doing first node now.
Maria Lopez: First node unlabelled and taint removed. A few pods are rescheduling back onto it. Pending count dropped from 120 -> 94.
Todd Nguyen: I'll bump the autoscaler min for the group: `gcloud compute instance-groups managed set-autoscaling spot-usw-3 --min-num-replicas 4` and push the change to infra repo. Pushing now.
autoscale-bot: autoscaler: minReplicas update requested for spot-usw-3 -> 4 (by Todd). Pending confirmation.
Jen Park: I'll deploy a one-off descheduler job (policy: removePodsViolatingInterPodAntiAffinity, consolidate by resource) to try and compact small leftover jobs. If it helps, we'll create a scheduled consolidation job during off-peak.
Kai Ito: Note: avoid using `descheduler` with `RemoveDuplicatePods` on stateful workloads. Limit to best-effort GPU batch jobs. I'll add toleration filters.
Ben Chiang: Good call. Also flagging this for follow-up: maintenance script should not apply `node-role=isolated` without checking pool size and autoscaler state. Maria/Todd can you add a precondition? (e.g., fail if pool.available < 5)
Maria Lopez: I'll add a check to the maintenance runbook and lock the label change behind a gate. Filing PR after this stabilizes.
Todd Nguyen: I'll open a PR to pause price-based aggressive scale downs for compact pools during maintenance windows.
sre-oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-1234 created (P2) — slack-thread linked. Assigned to eng-platform oncall.
Ben Chiang: Current status (10:25): Pending pods 94 -> 45 after first 3 nodes unlabelled + autoscaler min bumped. Descheduler started. Will watch for next 15m, will update again or close if it stabilizes.
Maria Lopez: 10:32 — Pending down to 12, most gang jobs scheduling. One misbehaving job stuck in CrashLoopBackoff, investigating logs now.
Jen Park: 10:40 — Descheduler cleaned up ~18 small pods; a couple of lower-priority ones got evicted and rescheduled to a different pool. Looks healthy.
Kai Ito: Follow-ups: (1) add precondition to maintenance script, (2) add a post-maintenance repack job (descheduler) as part of flow, (3) consider preventing autoscaler from scaling below X during maintenance windows, (4) evaluate using compact-scheduler constraints for gang-aware placement.
Ben Chiang: Thanks team. I'll update the incident and mark as monitoring. If things re-regress, we'll escalate to P1.
Maria Lopez: PRs: 1) maintenance gating (WIP), 2) autoscaler pause (WIP). I'll ping when merged. :thumbsup:
Todd Nguyen: Logging the autoscaler change in infra repo now.
sre-oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-1234 status -> monitoring.
